images.title: Reading the fraction wall
images.purpose: Show on the fraction wall that 1/2 and 3/6 of the same whole end at the same place, so they are the same length.
images.composition: One fraction wall of five rows centred with white space around it, and one dotted line dropping from the end of the half to the end of the third sixth.
images.exact_structure: A fraction wall of 5 rows, each row exactly the same length, edges lined up. Row 1 in 2 equal parts, row 2 in 3, row 3 in 4, row 4 in 5, row 5 in 6. In row 1 the left 1 part is filled teal #0072B2. In row 5 the left 3 parts are filled amber #E69F00. Rows 2, 3 and 4 stay plain. One reddish purple #CC79A7 dotted vertical line drops from the end of the teal part to the end of the third amber part, at the middle of the wall. Exactly 5 rows and 1 dotted line.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
rows of different lengths, or unequal parts within any row
images.takeaway: 1/2 and 3/6 end at the same place on the wall, so they are the same length.
images.description: A five row fraction wall from halves to sixths; the first half is shaded teal, the first three sixths are shaded amber, and a dotted line shows both end at the middle.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to follow the dotted line from the end of the half down to the end of the third sixth and say 1/2 = 3/6.

image_decisions.why: Reading equal lengths on a fraction wall is a picture idea; one image of the wall carries it.
